process.step1Desc: Fill personal, academic, and school posting details in a seamless 3-step form.
process.step2Desc: Select either Office Bearer (₹1000) or Yearly (₹120) plan as per your preference.
process.step3Desc: Complete payment through the secure Razorpay checkout. Membership activates only after backend verification.
process.step4Desc: Access your digital membership card after payment is verified by the backend. Registration alone does not activate membership.

values.val1Desc: Strong advocacy at government level for teachers' service rules, pay scale parity, and legitimate career advancement.
values.val2Desc: Complete digital records for member teachers, a secure database, membership cards after verified payment, and transparent audit.
values.val3Desc: Solidarity, regular dialogue, and mutual aid among government teachers across all 55 districts and 313 blocks.
values.val4Desc: Promoting innovative pedagogy, NEP workshops, classroom excellence, and holistic student development in government schools.

about.title: Shasakiya Shikshak Sangathan Madhya Pradesh
about.subtitle: A statutory, democratic, and forward-looking organization committed to the dignity, service security, and pedagogical advancement of all government teachers in Madhya Pradesh.
about.missionDesc: The primary mission of Shasakiya Shikshak Sangathan Madhya Pradesh is to protect the constitutional and service rights of every teacher working in primary, middle, and higher secondary schools, resolve seniority and time-scale pay anomalies with authorities, and ensure a dignified work environment.
about.valuesDesc: Transparency, integrity, democratic decision-making, and a teacher-first philosophy are our pillars. The Sangathan is completely non-political and steadfastly committed to educator welfare, student quality learning, and the holistic transformation of MP school education.
about.pillar1Desc: Continuous coordination with government bodies for the seamless execution of time-scale financial upgrades and timely release of promotion rosters.
about.pillar2Desc: Statewide democratic advocacy for the restoration of the Old Pension Scheme to secure the future of teachers and their families.
about.pillar3Desc: Establishment of a specialized IT Cell for online membership, digital ID issuance, e-circulars, and transparent grievance redressal.
about.ctaTitle: The Strength of the Sangathan — Every Fellow Teacher
about.ctaDesc: Join the official digital membership of Shasakiya Shikshak Sangathan Madhya Pradesh today and strengthen teacher solidarity.

organizationInfo.sectionSubtitle: Our purpose, special provision and membership eligibility
organizationInfo.purposeDesc: Holistic development of education, learners, schools and teachers across Madhya Pradesh.
organizationInfo.specialDesc: Membership of the organization shall be completely free of charge. No fee of any kind shall be payable for membership.
organizationInfo.eligibilityDesc: Teachers working in government schools under the School Education and Tribal departments across Madhya Pradesh, including former Shikshakarmis, Gurujis and Samvida Shala Shikshaks who later became members of the Adhyapak cadre and then Primary, Middle or Higher Secondary Teachers.
organizationInfo.joinDesc: Eligible government teachers in Madhya Pradesh can apply online for membership of the organization.
